commit_message: Add initial project setup and core infrastructure for Isaac_ROS-Jetbot_NanoOWL
This commit establishes the foundational structure for the Isaac ROS Jetbot NanoOWL project,
- Essential configuration files (.gitignore, .dockerignore, .env) for proper development workflow
- Complete project architecture with organized source modules (ROS2_Jetbot_NanoOWL, ROS2_Stereo,
- Docker containerization setup and Kubernetes deployment configurations
- Jupyter notebooks for stereo camera calibration, rectification, and visualization workflows
- Asset management structure with reference files and training resources
- Build automation scripts and CMake preprocessing tools
- Microcontroller integration components and OTA server capabilities
This initial setup provides a comprehensive foundation for developing advanced robotics
applications combining Isaac ROS with Jetbot hardware and NanoOWL object detection capabilities.
